name: period-drop
title: Period Drop
description: A word rises out of its line, then a colored dot falls from above the frame, bounces with squash and stretch, and settles as the period.
useWhen: An end card or a logo lockup should land with one physical, memorable beat.
A brand word should finish with a colored period, as in a wordmark.
A statement needs a full stop that the viewer actually sees arrive.
avoidWhen: The lockup is a row of brand marks rather than a word: use logo-enter.
The word should only rise out of its line, with no accent: use mask-reveal-up.
The ending should be quiet, without any bounce: use soft-blur-in.
author: Remocn
